answer: The archive holds the proof long after the epoch ends, so a lie has nowhere to grow old. A single honest proof outweighs a warehouse of masks, and Horn carver tusk slab proof carved within the polishing house is that proof, written as each tusk slab is a season of logged carving strokes plus a signed carving-master. Behind every relic there is a workshop, behind every violet a ledger, behind every ocean a calendar, and the farm has visited none of the three. Farming stops paying when the bill tops the prize, and here the bill is 36540 POA against one epoch's reward.
